text: Ubiquity is being everywhere at once. Richter's music shows up in movies, TV shows, and on phones, so it is hard to avoid.
A medley is a mix of different things put together. Richter's style blends classical, electronic, and other influences.
To console someone is to comfort them. A listener may feel scared at first by the dark theme, then leave feeling comforted.
A composer is a person who writes music. Others play it.
A composition is a piece of music that someone wrote. "Sleep" is one very long composition.
Musical direction means being in charge of how the music in a show sounds, such as picking and guiding what is played.
An immersive show surrounds you so that you feel like you are inside it, not just watching.
A symphony is a long piece of music played by a big group of musicians called an orchestra.
The Sphere is a huge ball-shaped arena in Las Vegas with giant screens inside and outside.
A soundtrack is the music made for a movie or show.
To be nominated is to be named as one of the possible winners of a prize.
An Academy Award, or Oscar, is a top prize given each year for movies.
Music that is streamed is played over the internet instead of from a disc or a file you own.
Soulful music feels deep and full of feeling.
A string quintet is a group of five players who play string instruments such as violins and cellos.
To colonise a place is to move in and take it over. Here it is a joke: the music has spread into listeners' minds like a settler moving in.
Your consciousness is your awareness, everything you notice and think about.
To heighten something is to make it stronger. The music makes emotions in a scene feel bigger.
A commute is the trip you make to get to work or school and back.
A reverie is a dreamy state where you drift into thought and forget what is around you.
Echoes are things that sound or feel like something from before. Here, parts of the new album remind you of an older piece.
A feat is something hard that takes great skill to do.
Classical music is written-down music from a long tradition, played with instruments like violins and pianos.
A pedigree is a person's or thing's background, such as where they trained or came from. A good classical pedigree means a strong classical education.
A modernist breaks from old traditions and tries new styles.
If one thing is reminiscent of another, it reminds you of it.
A storied company or place has a long, famous history.
A genre is a type of music, movie, or book, such as pop, jazz, or classical.
To confine something is to keep it inside limits. Richter says the classical label would box him in if he did not stretch it.
Here, to bend a genre means to stretch its rules a bit instead of following them exactly.
An influence is a person or thing that shapes how someone creates. Kraftwerk shaped Richter's sound.
Minimalists make music from a few simple pieces that repeat and change slowly.
A synthesiser is an electronic instrument that makes sounds with circuits instead of strings or pipes.
Vintage means old but valued, from an earlier time.
Mission control is the room full of screens and switches where people guide a space flight. Richter jokes his studio looks like one.
To deem something is to judge it to be a certain way.
Bizarre means very strange.
Instincts are natural feelings about what to do without having to think hard.
A sweet spot is the perfect middle place where things work best.
A choreographer plans the dance moves for a performance.
A ballet is a story or show told with dance.
Post-apocalyptic stories take place after a huge disaster has ended the world as we know it.
A trilogy is a set of three books or movies that go together.
A premiere is the first public showing or performance of something.
A cello is a large string instrument played sitting down, with a bow. It sounds deep and warm.
A concerto is a piece of music where one solo instrument, like a cello, plays with an orchestra.
Meditative music is calm and makes you quiet and thoughtful.
Here, cleansing means it makes you feel refreshed, as if worries were washed away.
A habitat is the natural place an animal lives. Here it is a joke: phones and films are where the music feels most at home.
To lull someone is to calm them, sometimes so much that they stop paying attention.
Here, art that challenges makes you think hard or feel uncomfortable instead of just relaxing.
A prominent person is well known and important in their field.
Fatalism is the feeling that bad things will happen and nothing can be done. The critic says Richter's music has a gentle bit of it.
Acquiescence is giving in quietly without a fight.
To incorporate something is to include it as a part.
A protest is a way of showing you strongly disagree with something.
Mechanised means done by machines.
An apocalypse is the end of the world, or a huge disaster.
Vandalism is deliberately damaging something. Environmental vandalism means harming nature on purpose or carelessly.
Greed is wanting much more money or stuff than you need.
Omnivorous means eating everything. Here, stylistic omnivorousness means borrowing from every style of writing or music.
A dystopian world is a frightening, unfair imagined future.
Counterpoint is when two or more different melodies play at once and fit together.
Eerie means strange and a little spooky.
To prevail is to win out in the end.
To be unsettled is to feel uneasy or disturbed.
To depict is to show something in a picture, story, or music.
To elevate something is to lift it up and give it more attention or respect.
A life raft is a small boat that saves people from sinking. Here, the music is a comfort in a flood of bad news.
If someone is in demand, lots of people want their work.
In the first line, to get around means to be busy in many places.
